status: Proposed canonical UI palette, awaiting owner review. No game files changed.

typography.case: Uppercase only for short labels and controls. Sentence case for descriptions and messages.

rules: Use opaque foregrounds. Control translucency through backings, never essential text.
Use square panels and controls. Keep angled ends in weapon glyphs and marker shapes; reserve circles for the minimap and radial indicators.
Keep hull and shield identities stable across player, ally and enemy. Put allegiance on marker shape and name, not resource fills.
Show current/max capacity in the study. Graduations remain an open choice under issue 1189.
Reserve coral for hostility, critical danger, negative changes and failure. Pair it with shape or text.
Pair warnings and objectives with distinct labels and marker shapes even though both are warm colors.
Use ivory for selected controls and weapon identities. Do not assign a separate decorative color to every weapon.
Keep minimap hues visible. No white bloom on player, enemy or asteroid markers.
Keep fixed ivory/coral/mint map precedents from PR 1002; ally and extraction marker shapes remain proposals.
Preserve green success and red loss outcomes from PR 1065.
Damage flashes must not be the sole cue. Respect reduced-motion preferences and avoid continuous flashing.
